offer_versions.name: Dealership website inquiry follow-through
offer_versions.buyer_type: Decision-maker at a single-location franchise or independent dealership (general manager, dealer principal, or the internet/BDC manager with authority to change how website inquiries are handled).
offer_versions.problem: Inquiries submitted through the dealership's own website land in a shared inbox or CRM queue where nobody owns them: response is slow or inconsistent, the handoff to a salesperson is informal, and the manager cannot see what happened to each inquiry without asking around.
prerequisites: One existing website inquiry form that already delivers submissions to an inbox, CRM or lead router the dealership controls
One named staff member (or rotation) who will accept the handoff and update a status
Delegated, least-privilege access to the existing channel (inbox rule, CRM user, or webhook), never a shared password
A written list of the fields the inquiry form collects, so consumer-sensitive fields can be excluded
A decision-maker available for a 30-minute acceptance walkthrough
deliverables: One dealership: the follow-through is configured for exactly one rooftop
One existing channel: every website inquiry is acknowledged and routed through the channel the dealership already uses (no new inbox, no new app for customers)
One staff handoff: each inquiry is assigned to one named person with a visible status (new, contacted, then appointment, closed or no response)
One reporting view: a single view of arrival time, first-response time, owner and current status, exportable weekly
exclusions: Not a lender or credit-application integration
Not a new DMS or a replacement for the dealership's CRM
Not a sales guarantee: no promised vehicle sales, appointments or gross
Not a claim that every dealer needs it; fit is decided per store after discovery
No outbound texting or calling of consumers on the dealership's behalf
No handling of credit, SSN, driver-licence or other sensitive consumer data
implementation_dependencies: Dealership grants delegated access to the existing channel before the schedule starts (milestone does not start without it)
The named handoff staff attend one 20-minute walkthrough
Hosting and model/telephony providers stay available (provider outage, then manual contingency, documented in the deal-control sheet)
The inquiry form keeps delivering submissions to the agreed channel; a form change is a change order
offer_versions.supported_proof_note: none yet: no customer results, references or case studies exist for this offer; nothing may be implied
offer_versions.approved_claims_note: none approved: the script may describe deliverables and acceptance criteria only

pillars.name: Same-day inquiry response
pillars.connects_to_problem: Inquiries sit unanswered in a shared inbox or queue with no owner and no clock.
pillars.delivery: Every website inquiry is acknowledged and routed through the dealership's existing channel inside an agreed response window, with the arrival time recorded.

pillars.name: One named handoff
pillars.connects_to_problem: Nobody owns the lead, so it is worked twice or not at all and the handoff to sales is informal.
pillars.delivery: Each inquiry is assigned to one named staff member with a visible status that they update as they work it; unclaimed inquiries are surfaced, not lost.

pillars.name: One honest reporting view
pillars.connects_to_problem: The manager cannot see what happened to an inquiry without asking around.
pillars.delivery: One view (arrival, first response, owner, status) for one rooftop, exported as a weekly summary; numbers are counts of recorded events, not projections.

timing.estimated: Estimated (not committed): configuration inside two weeks of access being granted; acceptance walkthrough in week three.
timing.committed: No committed dates exist for this draft. Committed timing is set only in a signed scope after access prerequisites are met.

acceptance_criteria: Test inquiries submitted through the live form appear in the reporting view with arrival time recorded
Each test inquiry is assigned to a named handoff person and its status can be changed by that person
The weekly summary exports for one full week without manual correction
No excluded consumer-sensitive field appears anywhere in the view or export
offer_versions.support: Email support during business hours for the configured rooftop; defects in the delivered configuration are fixed within the scope at no extra charge; new requests are change orders.
offer_versions.cancellation_exit_handoff: Either side may end the recurring service with 30 days' notice. The dealership's inquiries, staff records and existing channel remain theirs; the reporting data is exported to them on exit; delegated access is revoked by the dealership. Nonpayment leads to an agreed prospective pause, never withholding of the dealership's own data.
decision_roles: Economic decision: dealer principal or general manager
Operational owner: internet/BDC manager or sales manager who accepts the handoff
Access grantor: whoever administers the existing inbox/CRM

offer_versions.name: Demo Inquiry Follow-Through Pilot

prerequisites: Fictional customer provides delegated test access to a sandbox inbox (no real credentials)
One synthetic web inquiry form that generates test submissions
One named fictional staff member assigned to the handoff
deliverables: One web inquiry form connected for the 30-day scenario
Deterministic staff handoff: every synthetic inquiry is assigned by a fixed rule to the named fictional staff member
Status board showing each inquiry's owner and status
Weekly summary of arrivals, response times and statuses
exclusions: No promised vehicle sales, appointments or profit
No real consumer data of any kind; sensitive consumer data is excluded from the fixture
Not a real quote, never to be shown as live pricing
implementation_dependencies: Sandbox access granted before the scenario clock starts
Synthetic inquiries generated by the practice tool, not by real people

pillars.name: Deterministic staff handoff

pillars.name: Status board and weekly summary
